description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarArrivedAtFacility" name="Car arrives at service facility"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarArrived" name="Car arrived for service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceDue" name="Service due notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairDone" name="Repair done notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Payment" name="Payment received via app"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService" name="Car Service">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Police" name="Police Reminder App" processRef="Process_Police"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Car Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OwnerArrives" name="Car arrives" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="StartEvent_CarArrives"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NotifyPoliceVisit" name="Service visit" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyPolice" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_CarArrived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceDueToOwner" name="Service due" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusToOwner" name="Status update" sourceRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairDoneToOwner" name="Repair done" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyRepairDone" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentFromOwner" name="Payment" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceCompletedToPolice" name="Service completed" sourceRef="SendTask_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Police" name="Police Reminder App" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" name="Successful service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_CheckRegistration" name="Check car registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ExclusiveGateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner of due service" messageRef="Msg_ServiceDue"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRegistered" name="Reminder not sent"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventBasedGateway_AwaitVisit" name="Service visit or 30 days"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_CarArrived" name="Car arrives for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarArrived" messageRef="Msg_CarArrived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_Timer30" name="30 days passed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ServiceVisited" name="Service visited"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_IssueFine" name="Issue fine"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="ServiceTask_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToGateway" sourceRef="ServiceTask_CheckRegistration" targetRef="ExclusiveGateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="yes" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_Registered" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${carRegistered == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="no" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_Registered" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToEventGateway" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyOwner" targetRef="EventBasedGateway_AwaitVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCarArrived" sourceRef="EventBasedGateway_AwaitVisit" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_CarArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToTimer30" sourceRef="EventBasedGateway_AwaitVisit" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_Timer30"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CarArrivedToEnd" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_CarArrived" targetRef="EndEvent_ServiceVisited"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timer30ToFine" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_Timer30" targetRef="ServiceTask_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FineToEnd" sourceRef="ServiceTask_IssueFine" targetRef="EndEvent_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CarArrives" name="Car arrives at facility">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarArrivedAtFacility" messageRef="Msg_CarArrivedAtFacility"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyPolice" name="Notify police of service visit" messageRef="Msg_CarArrived"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="ParallelGateway_WaitSplit" name="Start waiting work"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_StatusUpdate" name="Send status update email" messageRef="Msg_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_Repair" name="Perform repair"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="ParallelGateway_WaitJoin" name="Repair and updates finished"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterSuccess" name="Enter successful repair and issue Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyRepairDone" name="Notify owner repair done" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Payment" name="Pay repair through app" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterNextService" name="Enter next service time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ServiceCompleted" name="Send service completed" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ServiceDone" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CarArrives" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyPolice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyPolice" targetRef="UserTask_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterProblems" targetRef="ParallelGateway_WaitSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="ParallelGateway_WaitSplit" targetRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="ParallelGateway_WaitSplit" targetRef="ManualTask_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="SendTask_StatusUpdate" targetRef="ParallelGateway_WaitJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="ManualTask_Repair" targetRef="ParallelGateway_WaitJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="ParallelGateway_WaitJoin" targetRef="UserTask_EnterSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F9" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterSuccess" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyRepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F10" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyRepairDone" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F11" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Payment" targetRef="UserTask_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F12" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterNextService" targetRef="SendTask_ServiceCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F13" sourceRef="SendTask_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="EndEvent_ServiceDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
